metrics.has_code: Presence of tagged block or inline code. Empty elements count as present.
metrics.has_block: Presence of an outermost pre element. Inline code is counted separately.
metrics.block_count: Number of outermost blocks in the article.
metrics.inline_count: Number of outermost inline code elements in the article.
metrics.block_chars: Block characters measured in Unicode code points.
metrics.inline_chars: Inline code characters measured in Unicode code points.
metrics.block_nonempty_lines: Total nonempty lines in code blocks.
metrics.inline_nonempty_lines: Total nonempty lines in inline code.
metrics.W_S: Sealed ASCII English word count for P+L+U.
metrics.block_chars_per_S_word: Block characters divided by W_S. NA if S0.
metrics.code_nonwhite_share: Nonwhitespace block and inline code characters divided by nonwhitespace visible DOM characters.
metrics.before_matched_share: Matched blocks divided by all blocks in the article. NA if there are no blocks.
metrics.before_matched_words_mean: Mean word count across matched rows within the article, including reused prose. NA with no matches, and 0 for matches with zero words.
metrics.before_matched_words_median: Auxiliary median word count across matched rows within the article, including reused prose.
metrics.before_unique_matched_words: Word count with each unit_index on this side included once per article. NA when there are no matches. Compute separately for the two sides.
metrics.after_matched_share: Matched blocks divided by all blocks in the article. NA if there are no blocks.
metrics.after_matched_words_mean: Mean word count across matched rows within the article, including reused prose. NA with no matches, and 0 for matches with zero words.
metrics.after_matched_words_median: Auxiliary median word count across matched rows within the article, including reused prose.
metrics.after_unique_matched_words: Word count with each unit_index on this side included once per article. NA when there are no matches. Compute separately for the two sides.

main_estimator: mean of annual article means: post minus pre; all six annual means required
supplemental_estimators: ratio of total numerator to total denominator; distinct from mean article ratio
same_month: reuse cohort.same_month_aux only; do not infer new month set

bootstrap.unit: known single numeric author, full-period cluster
bootstrap.rng: numpy.default_rng; sorted author IDs; includes authors outside main six years
bootstrap.low_coverage: NA main interval; no imputation, no threshold relaxation
bootstrap.targets: overall main year-equal differences only; no stratum CI or p values

strata.topic_primary: t02-strata-map priority over raw saved tags; unmatched unknown
strata.topic_multi: metadata-v2 topics, unique article membership per topic; overlaps retained
strata.tags: all saved tags unique per article; no-tag sentinel; no normalization beyond saved metadata
strata.language: all raw explicit class labels, unique article membership per label across block and inline; unknown if any unlabeled code; no_code separate; plaintext and mixed labels retained
strata.language_state: no_code, unknown_only, explicit_only, explicit_and_unknown; multi_label separate flag
strata.type: article_type plus ambiguous flag; descriptive only, never primary adjustment
strata.threshold: 30 member articles in EVERY main comparison year for tag detail and comparable strata; metric valid n must also meet 30 each year for stratum difference
strata.output: all membership year counts and rejected reasons; annual metric summaries for all topic/language/type/presence strata and eligible tags plus no_tag; failed metric threshold => reasoned NA difference
strata.overlap_denominator: within each label article n; sums across labels are not independent article totals

figures: W_S distribution by code presence, original and log1p scales
block/inline characters versus W_S, original and log1p scales, all articles
article before/after matched-word means, original and log1p; missing reasons explicit
annual focal means and code quantities; 2022/2025 descriptive
zeros: observed zero retained; S0 ratio NA; no block NA for adjacency; no matched on side NA for words; missing inputs NA, never zero
giant_code: retain all; original and log1p plus max/p99/top-share diagnostics, no trimming
source_review: freeze first 2 whitespace_only positions by existing processing order then code_index; old empty sample unchanged; remaining 24 uninspected
limits: CC English collection only; proximity is not semantic explanation; no DEV population/AI/causal/quality inference; no A09, final audit or complete
